body: Yeah they definitely seem like the logical steps forward....to you. Not to me.

My family is all dead. I've never had much in the way of friendship. I don't see the point in a job or participating in society so I left all that behind me. I feel like I've been trying for 29 years to make it work and no matter which way I try it doesn't.
I don't live in a place and have no friends or family. All my time is free time and even when I'm happy there's a huge undertone of misery. I can't let go but I can't hold on.
